title: Parag Agrawal - AI agents web ko 10000x badal denge
content:
Twitter ke former CEO kehte hain, hum AI agents ko TEN THOUSAND times underestimate kar rahe hain.
Ye hain Parag Agrawal. Twitter pe gyarah saal, engineer se CTO, phir CEO.
Ab wo Parallel Web Systems chalate hain, jo AI agents ke liye search APIs banati hai.
Kal ek podcast mein unhone ek bada number bola.
Unke hisaab se, aaj AI agents web ko humans ke mukable sirf TEN TO TWENTY PERCENT use kar rahe hain.
Aur unka original prediction tha ki agents humans se thousand times zyada web use karenge.
Toh unki math se, abhi bhi FIVE THOUSAND SE TEN THOUSAND x growth baaki hai.
This is his estimate, not a measured fact. But it comes from someone who tracks this every day.
Ek example unhone diya.
Ek average insaan din mein lagbhag das Google searches karta hai.
Aur jo agents wo khud track karte hain, wo din mein kai hazaar searches chalate hain.
Ab sawaal ye hai, Indian business ke liye iska matlab kya hai?
Yahin pe asli game hai.
Maan lo aapki ek chhoti travel agency hai Jaipur mein.
Kal ko ek customer apne AI agent ko bolega, "Mere liye teen din ka Jaipur trip plan karo, budget mein."
Woh agent aapki website padhega. Agar aapki prices, timings aur contact details clear nahi hain, toh agent aapko skip kar dega.
Your website is no longer just for humans. It is also for machines.
Toh aaj kya karein?
Step one. Apni website pe prices, services aur timings simple text mein likho, sirf images mein nahi.
Step two. Ek FAQ page banao jo seedha sawaalon ka jawab de.
Step three. Apna Google Business profile update rakho, kyunki agents bhi wahi data padhte hain.
Parag ne ye bhi kaha ki agar aapki site agent-friendly nahi hai, toh Parallel jaise tools wo kaam aapke liye kar sakte hain. But do not wait for that.
Mera take simple hai.
Pehle hum SEO karte the Google ke liye. Ab humein AGENTS KE LIYE BHI clear rehna hoga.
Jo business ye abhi samjhega, woh agle saal aage hoga.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
